initial_decision.brief_rationale: R293-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. The observed risk difference, 28/40 − 48/60 = −0.10, is descriptive. Exact population weights and passed arithmetic checks do not uniquely determine the average causal risk difference.
